instruction: Look at outer_plate.step in NX CAM. Create a Planar Mill or Profile Contour outside-boundary operation for outer_plate.step. Set the MCS origin at the part top-face center. Use T1, a 6 mm flat end mill, to machine the outside profile down to Z=0.000 mm. Apply 0.2 mm radial stock and one finish pass. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm flat end mill for Planar Mill/Profile Contour, S9000 rpm, F650 mm/min. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-2.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
